title: Pete Capitán (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word 105bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal proud character portrait
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dad saved his number under Pete Capitán
Not the first name, not the surname — just the man
What's in a name? Everything, Chas would say
The Captain's always there at the start of the day

[Verse 2]
Oldest son by seven years and counting
First to the table, first up in the morning
Rugby in his blood and salt air in his chest
Chas put it in the phone — and that said all the rest

[Chorus]
Pete Capitán, first over the line
Pete Capitán, been leading since nine
Rooftop to the ocean, hammer to the helm
Pete Capitán — it's always been your realm

[Bridge]
Corey's in the middle, Joel brings up the rear
But they both know who set the tone from year to year
You don't earn Capitán from your dad by sitting still
You earn it on the rooftop, you earn it on the swell

[Verse 3]
He's up at Pelican Charters, watching on the feed
Found the songs before we called him — that's Pete McIvor speed
Live wire never quits, oldest never stops
Pete Capitán — from the rooftop to the docks

[Outro]
Pete Capitán
Pete Capitán
That's my boy
That's my boy
